question: In which of the following plant groups, seeds are present inside the fruit?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Angiosperm**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Seeds are present inside the fruit in angiosperms**, which are also known** as flowering plants **
 
• The** term "angiosperm" comes from the Greek words angeion** ("container, vessel") and sperma ("seed").
 
• **After fertilization, the ovules develop into seeds, and the ovary wall forms the fruit around the seed. **
 
• Angiosperms** are different from gymnosperms**, which have naked seeds that are not enclosed in fruit.
 
• Gymnosperm **seeds are exposed or on the scales of cones, like a pine cone.**
